notes: The page continues a description by pairs (p,sigma) subject to relation (13), compares S E with S double-hatted E, identifies the restriction through Gamma_P, and describes the subgroup by automorphisms preserving L_0,L_1,L_infinity with the three rectificateurs g_i equal to 1. The author then explicitly writes Sans doute about extending the conclusion to the larger group and forcing p in {plus/minus 1}; the inserted correction by a tilded sigma_i precedes a statement that relation (14) forces p=1. He ends Exercice!, so this is a proposed exercise, not a proved theorem supplied here. Pair order (p,sigma) and then (sigma,p), and the different factor orders in (13)/(14), are kept as written. No independent mathematical verification was performed. All agreed words and symbols were inspected as well as the witness differences. The double hats on E and on the cancelled pi are distinct. H editorial notes were excluded; its recognition of cancellation is not counted as an error merely for using a note. Formula (14) has a dark paired-dot trace absent from both witnesses, retained as an unsure colon because its textual status is uncertain. No watermark, diagram, or additional marginal text was identified.
